role: Meta-gate: every scripts/check_*.sh and enforce_*.sh must be named somewhere in .github/workflows/ci.yml, except check_coverage.sh.
toplevel: set -euo pipefail; no cd. WORKFLOW env GATES_WORKFLOW_FILE or .github/workflows/ci.yml; missing -> exit 2. Python: plain substring test `gate.name in workflow`. Unwired -> exit 1; else clean. Wired: gates.yml, ci.yml, Makefile gates-wired-guard.

flags.text: Header says the gate proves each gate runs 'on a push', but it only checks ci.yml, which is workflow_dispatch/workflow_call only. The push workflow gates.yml omits coremotion-isolation-guard, hr-feed-link-guard and check_privacy_manifest_vocabulary.sh, and this gate passes.

A substring match counts mentions in YAML comments or in jobs skipped by `if:` as wired. Its comment says check_gate_preflight.sh and verify_gates_fail.sh are listed in NOT_A_STEP, but the map holds only check_coverage.sh.
